name: describe_prefab
summary: What a buildable prefab is before it stands anywhere, in its own frame: placement kind, the turns it takes, its cells, render box, ports, visual top and controls side. Read only.

help.text: Its own frame is unturned, x right, y up, z forward, origin snapped as the cursor snaps it. Returns prefab_name, prefab_hash, display_name, build_states, runtime_type, placement (grid, face or face_mount), grid_size_m, small_grid, rotation_axes, allowed_rotations [{facing, up, euler}], small_cells, render_box, grid_box, ports [{index, type, role, flow, at, outward}], visual_up, reversible_flow, has_cursor and controls.

visual_up.text: visual_up {local (the axis that reads as its top), lying_allowed, source, verified (true when seen live or forced by the game; false: a guess, or source ASSUMED for a prefab that builds any way up)}. controls {local (the axis its slots, buttons and switches face), votes, considered, source, fallback (true: no control sits clearly on one side, so forward +z stands in)}, left out for anything with no controls. reversible_flow: turbo volume pumps, whose Mode 0 and 1 move gas opposite ways.

prefab.description: Prefab name (StructureWallLight, as find_things and looking_at report them) or prefab hash.
